decisions.reason: After two years without clear negative signals, this camera remains a low-cost option tightly aligned with the firm's core space-imaging business in a growing market.
The modular multi-model line shows stronger commitment, customer adaptability, and fit with existing capabilities, so the option value of keeping it open clearly exceeds the cost.
As a recently launched radiation-hard camera line close to the core offer, it is still in the uncertainty-resolution phase and should be kept while market feedback develops.

This asteroid navigation and imaging camera is a more specialized and less established option, but its strategic upside for future missions justifies keeping it on the market for now despite higher uncertainty.
